brief: Pots on my balcony for three hot chilli pepper seedlings.

requirements.requirement: Each pot holds soil and one hot chilli pepper seedling

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell cluster of full-depth drained bins as balcony pots, filled with soil and each planted with a pepper seedling prop. Catalog has only sweet-pepper seedling (pepper-seedling) — no hot-chilli variant — so hot variety is approximate.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Hot chillies, coming up — setting out three balcony pots.
